notes.title: Northrealm Tribes B0923
notes.content: [h3]Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Reworked the Steam News UI for better readability.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked Windowed Borderless mode, which now functions correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Zoom speed is now set to [b]1 by default[/b], so you can move the camera immediately without adjusting settings.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug affecting the Russian language.[/p][/*][/list][h3]New Content[/h3][list][*][p]Added fish to the sea to make the water feel more alive.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Platform Support[/h3][list][*][p][b]Linux support added[/b]: players on Linux operating systems can now play the game.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Northrealm Tribes B0811
notes.content:
[h1][b]Update[/b]: B0811[/h1]
[list]
[*]Loot spawn time changed to 600 - 3600 seconds.
[*]The probability of spawning more than one loot item has been increased.
[*]User interface completely redesigned.
[*]Languages added: Russian, German.
[*]Settings menu implemented.
[*]3D models revised.
[/list]

[h1][b]Update[/b]: B028[/h1]
[list]
[*]Tradership added (animated sequence for trading at the marketplace).
[*]You can now click on all buildings except the storage to open the building menu, where you can demolish, level up, or repair the building.
[*]Buildings lose durability over time and may collapse, disappearing completely.
[*]As a building loses durability, its appearance changes over time, making the damage visible.
[*]Protective walls have been added.
[/list]

[h1][b]Update[/b]: A0710[/h1]
[list]
[*]Minimap improved: icons and other markers now provide clearer information.
[*]The minimap now shows villagers performing tasks in white, while those without a job or assignment are shown in red.
[*]The minimap now indicates the radius where fields near the windmill need to be placed to remain permanent.
[*]Wood and stone roads have been added, but they serve only as decoration.
[*]A smithy has been added (required to construct houses and other buildings).
[*]A marketplace has been added (you can now trade your resources for gold or purchase resources with gold).
[/list]

[h1][b]Update[/b]: A063[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fields near the windmill no longer get damaged.
[*]Minimap icons are now displayed at the correct location.
[*]Villagers who are not working are now displayed in red.
[*]Loot boxes no longer disappear underground when they are washed ashore.
[/list]

[h1][b]Update[/b]: A059[/h1]
[list]
[*]All monitor sizes are now supported for the UI.
[*]Levels no longer go beyond 100.
[*]The XP bar resets back to zero when 100% is reached.
[*]Resources are now properly loaded on the first startup.
[/list]

notes.title: Northrealm Tribes A056
notes.content:
We're excited to announce an update for Northrealm Tribes, Version A056, which introduces several enhancements and new features designed to improve your gaming experience. Here's what's new:

[b]Optimized Warehouse Resource Management System[/b]: We've made significant improvements to the warehouse resource storage system, making it more efficient and user-friendly.

[b]Introduced a Level System[/b]: A brand-new leveling system has been implemented to add depth and progression to your gameplay. Please note, however, that progress saving for this system is still under development and will be fully functional in a future update.

[b]Credits Page Added[/b]: We've added a Credits page to acknowledge the hard work and dedication of everyone involved in bringing Northrealm Tribes to life. We believe it's important to recognize the team's effort and passion.

[b]Optimized Viking Wave Attacks[/b]: The Viking wave attacks have been refined for a more balanced and engaging challenge. However, they will remain deactivated until the Beta release to ensure a smooth and polished gameplay experience.

We're dedicated to continuously improving Northrealm Tribes and appreciate your support and feedback. Stay tuned for more updates as we work towards creating an unforgettable gaming experience.

notes.title: NortrealmTribes A044
notes.content:
[b]Enhanced Control Stability:[/b] Say goodbye to losing control when navigating menus! With the latest update for Northrealm Tribes Version A044, we've resolved an issue where players would lose control upon accessing the menu. Now, you can seamlessly switch between gameplay and menu navigation without any interruptions or unexpected glitches.

[b]Engine Upgrade to 5.3:[/b] We've upgraded to the latest engine version 5.3! With this upgrade, we're providing our players not only with improved performance and stability but also with an optimized gaming experience. Immerse yourself in the world of Northrealm Tribes and enjoy an even smoother and more impressive gaming environment.

[b]New Functions Preview:[/b] We've already integrated new features such as the Leveling System, although it's not yet fully functional and remains deactivated for now. Stay tuned as we fine-tune this feature to ensure it enhances your gaming experience to the fullest.

[b]Viking Assault Waves Preview:[/b] Viking attack waves are already implemented but temporarily deactivated. However, they will be activated during the beta testing phase to allow players to enjoy the full gaming experience. Get ready to defend your realm against epic Viking assaults!

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b] Additionally, we've addressed various bugs and issues to ensure a smoother and more enjoyable gaming experience for all players.
